articles.title: Fire breaks out at grass patch off Whampoa HDB block
articles.content: The affected area, about the size of a boxing ring, is near a carpark. A thick smoke plume was seen from across the road at about 500 metres away. Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) firefighters arrived shortly after. In response to AsiaOne's queries, SCDF said that the fire near Block 34 Whampoa West affected an area measuring about five by five metres. The cause of fire is under investigation
